# aioimaplib
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iroco-co/aioimaplib/a4453a66e38f0b5b748a4b26647727b0268beab1/aioimaplib/aioimaplib.py
This is a modified version of the upstream library
We fix the `examine` command implementation as a regular command instead of `simple_commands` 
We add support for starttls https://github.com/iroco-co/aioimaplib/issues/1#issuecomment-309870342

# imaplib
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/4172644d78d58189e46424af0aea302b1d78e2de/Lib/imaplib.py
This is the python 3.14 stdlib version (without modifications)
In this version the library gained supports for IDLE
